node.title: Revaloración antes de clarificar
node.summary: Reconstruct contribution, dependencies, substitutes and tacit knowledge before deciding continuity.

relations: The proposed sequence is to reconstruct contribution and replacement consequences before turning ownership clarity into a capability-retirement decision.
Es una hipótesis de tratamiento, no afirmación de que todo legado debe preservarse ni de que la secuencia haya demostrado superioridad general.
An expanding operational role can reveal previously unrecognized capability, which still requires bounded contribution and replacement evidence before being valued.
No atribución de la totalidad de PEMEX o Chicontepec a GEPLAN ni inferencia de derechos de propiedad a partir de uso.
Diamond Inside's value-discovery proposition can be examined through the revaluation-before-clarification hypothesis without treating a potential opportunity as realized financial value.
No todos los activos ocultos son diamantes, y una contribución detectada puede ser sustituible, costosa o legítimamente prescindible.
